description: This file is a React component for the finalized persona view in a Next.js application. It handles fetching and displaying a finalized persona's details, including loading logic, fallback mechanisms, and rendering user interface elements such as headers, summaries, competencies, and career highlights.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Type guard function to check if a value is a non-empty object.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown input to a string array if possible, filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: coerceCareerHighlights
methods.description: Transforms various input formats into an array of CareerHighlightItem objects, normalizing strings and objects.

methods.name: extractFinalPersonaFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts the final persona data from different possible structures returned by orchestration build records.
